scripts.dev: npm run build -w shared && concurrently -n server,client -c blue,green "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.build: npm run build -w shared && npm run build -w client && npm run build -w server
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w shared && npm run typecheck -w client && npm run typecheck -w server
scripts.test: npm run test -w shared && npm run test -w client
scripts.test:e2e: npm run build -w shared && npx playwright test --config=e2e/playwright.config.ts
